ticket.summary: Newsletter signup button does nothing on Safari
ticket.description: Clicking Subscribe on the footer form does nothing in Safari 17. The click handler uses a form.requestSubmit() polyfill that is missing. Make the button submit in Safari.

changes.title: Fix footer signup submit in Safari
changes.description: Replaces requestSubmit() with a submit-event dispatch fallback in FooterSignup.tsx and adds a Safari regression test.

ticket.summary: Put the new video player behind a feature flag
ticket.description: Wrap the new VideoPlayerV2 in a flag named video_player_v2, default off, so we can ramp it by percentage.

changes.title: Add video_player_v2 flag
changes.description: VideoPlayerV2 now renders only when flag video_player_v2 is on. Default is off in flags.json.

changes.title: Add flag to staging config
changes.description: Sets video_player_v2 to 10 percent in the staging flag file.

ticket.summary: Change 'Sign up' to 'Subscribe' on the article footer CTA
ticket.description: Copy change only. The footer call to action on article pages should read Subscribe instead of Sign up.

changes.title: Footer CTA copy: Subscribe
changes.description: Changes the label string in article footer from 'Sign up' to 'Subscribe'. Updates the snapshot.

ticket.summary: Add share buttons for Facebook and X to article pages
ticket.description: Article pages need share buttons for both Facebook and X, with the right share URLs and an analytics click event for each.

changes.title: Add Facebook share button
changes.description: Adds a Facebook share button with the share URL to the article toolbar. X is not included.

ticket.summary: Bump axios to 1.7.4 to fix the CVE
ticket.description: Upgrade axios to 1.7.4 across the web app and the image proxy service, both pin 1.6.x.

changes.title: Bump axios to 1.7.4 in web app
changes.description: Updates axios in the web app package.json and lockfile. The image proxy is untouched.

ticket.summary: Track clicks on the weather widget
ticket.description: Fire a widget_click analytics event when a user clicks the weather widget.

changes.title: Weather widget click event
changes.description: Fires widget_click on the weather widget. Also removes the legacy ticker component and its tests, which nothing else uses.

ticket.summary: Fix broken thumbnail on the live blog card
ticket.description: Live blog cards show a broken image when the lead photo has no 16x9 crop. Fall back to the 4x3 crop.

changes.title: Update eslint config
changes.description: Turns on the no-unused-vars rule and fixes the warnings in utils/format.ts.

ticket.summary: Add a dark mode toggle to settings
ticket.description: Settings page needs a dark mode toggle that is remembered across visits.

changes.title: Settings page: fix typo in privacy heading
changes.description: Corrects 'Privcy' to 'Privacy' in the settings page heading. The settings page file is touched only for that line.

ticket.summary: Cache the election results API response for 30 seconds
ticket.description: Add a 30 second cache on the election results endpoint to cut load on the backend.

changes.title: Rename ResultsTable props
changes.description: Renames the rows prop to items in ResultsTable and its callers. No behavior change.

ticket.description: See the attached document from legal for the new list of links.
Remove the unused OldBanner component and its stylesheet from the homepage. Nothing imports it any more.

changes.title: Remove OldBanner
changes.description: Deletes OldBanner.tsx, OldBanner.css and its test. A grep shows no remaining imports.

ticket.summary: Add alt text and captions to gallery images
ticket.description: Gallery images need both alt text and a visible caption, taken from the CMS fields.

changes.title: Gallery alt text
changes.description: Renders the CMS altText field as the alt attribute on gallery images. Captions are not done here.

changes.title: Gallery captions
changes.description: Renders the CMS caption field under each gallery image. Follows the alt text change.

ticket.summary: Fix broken thumbnail on the video card
ticket.description: Video cards show a broken image when the poster has no 16x9 crop. Fall back to the 4x3 crop when there is no 16x9 crop.

changes.title: Hide broken video card image
changes.description: When the 16x9 crop is missing, the card hides the image instead of showing a broken one. No 4x3 crop is used.

ticket.summary: Show a breaking news banner on the homepage
ticket.description: Add a breaking news banner at the top of the homepage, driven by the alerts feed.

changes.title: Breaking news banner
changes.description: Adds BreakingBanner to the homepage, reading the alerts feed.

changes.title: Revert breaking news banner
changes.description: Reverts !145 in full. The banner and its feed code are gone.
